label.basis: The Nevada Gaming Commission revoked the Fremont Hotel's licence in 1979 over about $7 million taken from the Argent casinos, and Online Nevada calls Argent a front for Midwest crime families.

venues.corrections: Label 'documented' stands on the commission action. The 'Strawman case brought convictions' claim is not confirmed: no court record opened; Wikipedia says 15 were indicted in 1983, and Glick was never charged. Also check Teamsters-loan and Dalitz thread (1961) against the 1956 owners.

venues.corrections: Dates agree. Laughlin died in Oct 2023 (obituary), so 'founded by' stands; current ownership by his family was not checked.

No court opinion on the Argent skim ('Strawman') or its outcome was found or opened; Nevada Gaming Control Board and Commission pages were not opened for any venue.
